preact/hooks.message: A card's ids come from useScopedId in design/ids.ts: a card drawn live on a page beside cards drawn at build time would otherwise take ids they already hold.

zod.message: The design draws what the widget has read and reads nothing itself: zod stays in src/widget, out of the script of the home page's demo, which draws cards it never reads.

patterns.message: The site's checker judges a built directory and knows nothing of what drew it: a check that calls the builder's code tests that a function equals itself.
